title: Seeing a row does not mean being allowed to edit it
goal: Test object and row-level restrictions with negative cases without broadening permissions.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P9. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A reader opens a 30-minute request and enters a valid 25, but the update is refused. This is not a range error: action permission and visible-data scope are separate checks.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Authorization checks an action
paragraphs: A role permits object operations; data restrictions refine scope. A user allowed Alpha requests does not gainBeta access merely by knowing a key. Test lists, direct open and edits. Hidden buttons and editable client filters are not authorization enforcement.

The available worked route uses the separate training roles described in this lesson. These are infobase roles, not Nexus accounts/RLS. Use an otherwise valid write so range validation is not mistaken for an authorization rejection.

sections.title: Permissions can combine
paragraphs: Additional roles change effective permissions. Analyze the full set and context, not one role alone. Full rights can hide missing enforcement. Use separate synthetic least-privilege profiles and a positive control so a denial is not merely an inability to log in.

For advanced RLS in another copy restrict document Read with WHERE ДлительностьМинут <=30, matching the current schema. Do not load the historical Минуты fixture over learner work. A second broader role can widen access; inspect the complete role set.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: If 25 is within the valid range, must a reader be able to save it?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. A value can be valid while the role forbids the action. Use a valid 25 in the negative case and reread the prior minutes; otherwise a range refusal can be mistaken for working access control.

sections.title: Privilege needs justification
paragraphs: Privileged execution can alter normal permission boundaries. Do not enable it merely to silence a read error; justify need and outputs. Even aggregates can disclose forbidden information. Agree on a minimal contract and test indirect routes as well as visible records.

The final 12 values yield 5 visible records:30, 15, 0, 20, 25, total 90. Compare SELECT ALLOWED with an unrestricted query in an admitted own module: one returns the subset; access to prohibited rows must reject. Separately the administrator sees 12/440.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: Data scope and action permission are checked separately. In the independent task, an own marker separates 30/35 from the previous 12 documents. Fictional 1C profiles are not Nexus accounts.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: A second role grants broad reading to the restricted profile. Analysing only its first role is now incomplete. Check the full role set and direct data access; hiding a button does not establish a prohibition.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Bind the matrix to the actual environment
paragraphs: Record build, profile, object, action, scope and expectation. TestAlpha, Beta, direct references, writes and aggregates in a suitable stand. Mark unavailable training checksNOTRUN. Logs contain no passwords or full user data; successful login is not a complete security audit.

Record permitted object reading, denied update,30/35 boundary and unchanged prior fields. Own synthetic profiles need no password/OS authentication for this exercise. If the edition lacks the mode, complete object-right checks and leave RLS explicitly NOT RUN.
